title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Smartsheet
providers.scope_notes: API tokens need Business/Enterprise/AWM; SAML, token expiration and Directory Integration are Enterprise; Event Reporting is an Enterprise/AWM add-on; Gov and Regions use separate tokens.

controls.name: API Access Token expiration period
controls.what: Sets one expiration for all existing and future user and OAuth tokens in the plan; expired tokens are revoked.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Security & Control > API Access Token tile > Expiration period
controls.quote: Once a System Admin sets expiration times, all existing and future tokens within the plan adhere to this duration and are automatically revoked upon expiration.

controls.name: Revoke access token (DELETE /token)
controls.what: Revokes the token used to make the call; later calls with it fail.
controls.quote: Revokes the access token used to make this request. The access token is no longer valid, and subsequent API calls made using the token fail.

controls.name: deleteAllForApiClient
controls.what: Revokes every token for the same app client ID and user.
controls.quote: A value of true deletes all tokens associated to the given client ID and user ID.

controls.name: OAuth access scopes
controls.what: App gets only consented scopes, still bounded by the user's sharing permissions.
controls.quote: Access scopes don't override existing access-level restrictions (that is, sharing permissions).

no_control.quote: You can’t assign individualized or role-based expiration dates, as this is a general setting for all tokens under the specified plan.

no_control.what: Visibility of OAuth token usage on the Admin Center API page
no_control.quote: User-generated tokens only:  The data reflects tokens generated by individual users, not OAuth tokens.

controls_unknown: Whether SAML-only sign-in, domain-level SAML or domain strict blocks or re-checks existing or new personal tokens (docs are silent; only sign-in and sessions are described).

auth_paths.name: OAuth 2.0 app (authorization code; access + refresh tokens)

authentication.summary: Three-legged authorization-code flow: user signs in and consents to scopes, app exchanges code with client ID and secret at POST /token. Access token is a bearer token limited by scopes and the user's sharing permissions.

federation.details: Consent requires the user to sign in through the normal Smartsheet sign-in (which may be SAML). After that, refresh tokens issue new access tokens with no user involvement; docs don't say SSO policy is re-checked at refresh.

ip_restriction.boundary: No doc found on IP restrictions for OAuth tokens.

lifetime.summary: Access token ~7 days; Enterprise plan-wide expiration also applies to OAuth tokens; refresh token lifetime not documented

renewal.expiry_basis: access token 604799 s; refresh token unknown
renewal.summary: POST /token with grant_type=refresh_token returns a new access and refresh token pair.

administration.summary: Developer Tools must be activated by Smartsheet for the developer account before apps can be registered. Apps request scopes at consent. Plan-wide token expiration applies. The Admin Center API page excludes OAuth tokens.
administration.conditions: No documented admin allowlist/blocklist for third-party OAuth apps.

sso.details: Same external-collaborator API rule applies; no doc ties OAuth token issuance or use to SSO for internal users.

offboard.details: SCIM offboarding neutralizes the user's OAuth tokens; manual deactivation revokes the user's access tokens.

inventory.details: No admin list of OAuth grants found; Event Reporting ACCESS_TOKEN - AUTHORIZE events include the app's client Id.

inventory.api: GET https://api.smartsheet.com/2.0/events?since=<date>; keep objectType=ACCESS_TOKEN, action=AUTHORIZE; additionalDetails.appClientId identifies the app

sso.ui: Admin Center > Settings > Secure External Access > Require work accounts with single sign-on (SSO) = On (external collaborators only)

reads.api: GET https://api.smartsheet.com/2.0/events?since=<date>; keep objectType=SHEET, action=LOAD; match additionalDetails.accessTokenName

offboard.ui: Admin Center > Users and Groups > Seat Types and True-up > user row ⋮ > Deactivate

token_format.notes: No documented prefix. Access token plus refresh token returned by POST /token.

log_sources.name: Event Reporting
log_sources.notes: Same plan gate; AUTHORIZE events carry appClientId and appName. OAuth tokens are not on the Admin Center API page.

credential_id_fields.notes: App the token was granted to.

anomaly_cues: AUTHORIZE for an unfamiliar appClientId, especially with ADMIN_USERS or READ_EVENTS in accessScopes.
REFRESH continuing after the user left.

containment.steps: Call DELETE /token?deleteAllForApiClient=true with a token for that app and user; or set a short plan-wide expiration.
containment.notes: Requires holding a token for the app. Whether user deactivation or a UI action revokes OAuth grants is not documented.
